trials.failure: The broker stored ACTION_CONDITION_FAILED as HTTP 409 but its duplicate response mapping returned HTTP 400 to the guest. The protected failed-action fixture returned 0 instead of 1; its containing test also failed.
trials.correction: Use the same status mapping for the actual guest response and durable failed-observation trace. No assertion or timeout is relaxed.

trials.coverage: Real PostgreSQL, native HTTP/processes and Docker: fenced scheduling and delivery; single-attempt isolation; lost public acceptance and publication COMMIT responses; SIGKILL and deadline-driven admission release; live generic-seal, mutation-acknowledgement and worker-scope rejection; nested functions, prepared actions, taint and retained evidence; native worker CLI process replacement.

All prior real fault/isolation/authority cases plus an actual guest filesystem move committing retained classification, a monotonic own-mutation epoch acknowledgement/audit, filesystem receipt and successful function result. Shared sandbox mechanism tables preserve the Function compatibility views and all Function authority checks.
